description: 🤯 Ever tried to make a short video using Claude Code, only to end up with five different open tabs and a massive headache? ❌ You type a prompt, get a script, copy it over to a voice app, download that file, jump into a caption editor, and then realize the timing is completely ruined. Everything breaks, files get lost, and you feel like you're completely losing control of the wheel. That is not your fault. That's just what happens when you try to force five disconnected apps to talk to each other. We just dropped a breakdown of a system called OpenMontage that lets Claude Code take over the entire video factory line. You give it one single brief, and it automatically handles the script, voice, visual arrangement, and final check in one smooth sequence without you bouncing between tools. It hooks into 12 different automated paths and over 500 individual smart skills. And you don't need to know what any of that means — it just works to give you a finished clip. Comment and DM me "PROMPT" below and I'll DM you the OpenMontage Prompt Workflow to turn your raw ideas into fully finished videos in a single push 🚀
